mapper.select: SELECT dat.departure_time,sd.station_cd AS departure_station_cd,sd.name AS departure_station_name,dat.arrival_time,sa.station_cd AS arrival_station_cd,sa.name AS arrival_station_name FROM T_Purchase AS p INNER JOIN M_DepartureArrivalTime AS dat ON p.schedule_cd=dat.schedule_cd AND p.id=#{purchase_id} INNER JOIN M_SectionKm AS sk ON dat.section_cd=sk.section_cd INNER JOIN M_Station AS sd ON sk.start_station_cd=sd.station_cd INNER JOIN M_Station AS sa ON sk.goal_station_cd=sa.station_cd ORDER BY dat.departure_time;
